image_prompt: A playful and abstract scene depicting a transition from miscommunication to clarity. On the left side, two stylized, cartoon-like characters are speaking, but their 'speech bubbles' contain swirling, jumbled pictograms, question marks, and confused expressions, symbolizing misunderstanding. On the right side, the same characters are clearly conversing, with speech bubbles showing simple, understandable symbols or words, and expressions of understanding. A vibrant, colorful bridge or a clear path connects these two scenarios. The Portuguese sentence "Para ser entendido, você precisa se comunicar." is written clearly on this bridge, symbolizing the essential connection. Bright, friendly color palette with distinct areas for confusion and clarity.
short_sentence: Para ser entendido, você precisa se comunicar.
caption: Parece óbvio, né? Mas quantas vezes a gente se esquece? 🗣️ Para ser entendido, você precisa se comunicar! Qual a sua dica para uma comunicação clara? Deixe nos comentários! 👇 #CoisasÓbvias #ComunicaçãoClara #DicaDoDia #Entendimento
